text: 加拿大皇家银行资本市场部分析师在一份报告中表示，尽管能源价格进一步上涨的风险依然存在，但战术性做多欧洲政府债券的风险回报比已有所改善。分析师称：“无论能源价格从当前水平进一步飙升（例如地缘政治局势升级），还是因局势缓和而再度回落，都可以设想债券市场从当前水平出现一轮战术性反弹。”加拿大皇家银行资本市场部长期以来一直看空债券市场，该行认为，支撑当前收益率水平的结构性背景并未改变。“不过，从战术层面看，我们认为市场仍可能进一步修正。面对加息预期升温和债券收益率高企，经济活动未来能够保持多大韧性，仍有待观察。”
text_en: RBC Capital Markets analysts said in a report that although the risk of further energy price increases remains, the risk-reward ratio for tactically going long European government bonds has improved. "Whether energy prices spike further from current levels (for example, due to an escalation in geopolitical tensions) or fall back again on easing tensions, one can envisage a tactical rebound in the bond market from current levels," the analysts said. RBC Capital Markets has long been bearish on the bond market and believes the structural backdrop supporting current yield levels has not changed. "However, tactically, we believe the market could still correct further. It remains to be seen how resilient economic activity can remain in the face of rising rate-hike expectations and high bond yields."
